Kosminis Vytis is an electronics company based in Lithuania, specializing in high-grade navigation equipment for professional applications. With a strong focus on precision and reliability, using GNSS chipsets licensed from NTLAB UAB (Lithuania), we create high-precision multi-system multi-frequency GNSS receiver modules, CRPA antennas and other satellite and GNSS/INS navigation devices.
In addition to our navigation modules, we are recognized for our expertise in anti-jamming technology. Our products excel in environments with high levels of signal interference, guaranteeing uninterrupted operation of navigation systems and related applications.
Furthermore, we offer a comprehensive range of GNSS equipment, including GNSS/INS solutions, CORS, and specialized tools for GNSS research. This diverse portfolio establishes us as a one-stop-shop for all GNSS needs, catering to both basic navigation requirements and advanced research and development applications.
Our company’s design process is fully integrated in-house, covering all aspects from schematics development and PCB design to software and mechanical engineering. We work closely with leading SMT assembly houses for device manufacturing, ensuring quality production under the supervision of our experienced engineers.

For customers who wish to localize production and market GNSS equipment under their own brand, we offer a licensing business model. Through this model, we provide all design documentation, including schematics, PCB files, and software source codes, enabling customers to set up their own production facilities. We also offer comprehensive technical support to ensure a thorough understanding of the product, manufacturing process, and maintenance procedures. Additionally, we facilitate the supply of necessary components (chipsets) for production.
At Kosminis Vytis, we continuously strive to push the boundaries of navigation technology. Our dedicated team of engineers, developers, and researchers is committed to innovation, ensuring that our products remain efficient, effective, and at the forefront of the industry’s evolving demands.

Founded in 2000, ZIRAK s.r.l. is a SME focused on IT, with excellent technical and scientific competence, thanks to a team of doctoral students, researchers, and developers from prestigious Italian institutions, including the Politecnico di Torino, the Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa, the Fondazione Links, and renowned European institutions such as the NovaLincs research laboratory in Portugal and the University of Beira Interior (UBI).
Over the past 23 years, ZIRAK has specialized in the automotive, home automation, and embedded sectors, extending its expertise to more cross-cutting areas such as scientific software, web solutions, and mobile applications. Since 2018, ZIRAK has successfully transferred these technological competencies to the environmental sector, focusing on cutting-edge areas such as:
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) applied to Earth Observation to address problems related to invasive plant species, monitoring of forests, rivers, infrastructure, anomalies, and to support the prediction of anomalous conditions and related alarms.
- Computer Vision (CV) algorithms to integrate AI models and provide more intuitive metrics and indicators, customized to customer needs, and useful for continuous process improvement.
- Customized Earth Observation (EO) platforms to meet the needs of individual institutions and allow access to citizens, managing large volumes of data (Big Data).
- Management of aerial data obtained from satellites, equipped vehicles, and drones, with RGB, multispectral, hyperspectral, LIDAR images, etc., also in collaboration with partners specialized in these technologies.
ZIRAK's headquarters are located in Mondovì (CN), with an office in Turin and a research and development laboratory in Portugal.

Focusing on system engineering, the new master’s is held in English and is open for up to 30 students from all over the world every year. entityDescription: FEAC Engineering P.C. is an engineering & consulting company, highly specialized in Simulation Driven Product Development & physics-based Digital Twins. The company is based in Greece and operates in the global market by developing and providing specialized simulation software and consulting services, to solve challenging & complex engineering problems. FEAC’s worldwide awarded services range from Computer Aided Design (CAD) drafting, advanced multiphysics Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Boundary Element Analysis (BEM) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) and design optimization techniques. There is extensive experience in project management & certification of products (CE marking) as well. FEAC combines 1D-simulation (aka system simulation) with detailed 3D simulation techniques (CFD, FEM, BEM) to build up a comprehensive Digital Twin of the process or object/assembly, not only in the phase of the development, but also in the phase of realization (manufacturing process) and operation (under operational conditions). This allows FEAC to create a Holistic Digital Twin throughout the product’s lifecycle. Our expertise is to develop multi-physics, high-fidelity simulations that couple structural mechanics, heat transfer, fluid flow, electromagnetics, acoustics, etc., and represent the mechanical behavior of components under complex environmental conditions. Due to the company’s high expertise in Simulation, Siemens Digital Industries Software has appointed FEAC Engineering as the exclusive authorized partner of its CAE portfolio in the countries of Greece, Cyprus & Malta. FEAC develops PITHIA-CP, a world-leading Boundary Element Solver for Cathodic Protection Digital Twins, which is used by SIEMENS as an add-on on its Simcenter 3D software portfolio. FEAC has offered its expertise in physics-based simulations to numerous engineering companies, product manufacturers from a wide range of industries, research centers and universities yielding to an impressive portfolio of delivered projects.

Railnova is a company that provides hardware and software solutions for rail vehicle maintenance and operations. They specialize in developing advanced telematics devices that collect real-time data from trains, analyze it using machine learning algorithms, and provide actionable insights to operators and maintenance teams.
One of the key spatial technologies that Railnova uses is GPS (Global Positioning System), which allows them to track the location and movement of trains in real-time. By integrating GPS data with other sensors on board, such as accelerometers and temperature sensors, Railnova can provide a comprehensive view of the train's health and performance.

Railnova's hardware solutions also incorporate patented FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) technology, which allows their devices to connect to any data protocol and field bus on board trains from any manufacturer. This technology provides Railnova with a high level of flexibility and interoperability, enabling their devices to work seamlessly with a wide range of onboard systems and equipment and capture mission critical data such as energy consumption, fault codes, and real time telemetry.
FPGAs are reconfigurable integrated circuits that can be programmed to perform specific tasks, allowing Railnova to customize their devices to the unique requirements of each train they work with. This approach also means that Railnova can quickly adapt to changes in the industry and new technologies, as they can update their devices with new software as needed.

entityDescription: Reactive Robotics has developed the world’s first AI-driven robotic assistance system for early mobilization of patients on intensive care units. The VEMOTION system consists of a mobile robotic device on a trolly as well as several electrical intensive care beds. This modularity allows medical personnel to transform the bed of the patient into a therapy device. This means that the patient does not have to be transferred to a separate device, which is dangerous for the patient and physically challenging for the nursing staff. The use of the VEMOTION system allows for therapy of patients that would otherwise not receive it, due to the severity of their condition or the lack of nursing staff in the hospital. Manual early mobilisation requires 3-5 caregivers, while robotically assisted early mobilisation only requires 1 caregiver. Early mobilisation is shown to reduce the length of stay of a patient by over 20%, while reducing secondary complications, such as loss of muscle mass or bone density.

description:
Covering 70% of our blue planet, the marine environments are essential to our survival as they play a significant role in the global carbon cycle, representing the largest long-term carbon sink. However, they are constantly exposed to a high level of climate pressure, mostly due to the polution (accumulation of waste). If degraded or lost, these ecosystems are likely to release most of their carbon back into the atmosphere. Plastics are the largest, most harmful, and most persistent fraction of the marine pollution, accounting for at least 85% of total marine litter. 165 million tonnes of plastic currently circulates in Earth's marine environments and prevent the absorption of up to 8.25 billion tonnes of CO2 each year.

The mismanagement of plastic waste is a global challenge that must be immediately addressed if we are to achieve the SDGs or meet the targets set out in the 2015 Paris Agreement. 

Recycllux provides means for a faster and more efficient collection of marine plastic by applying machine-learning algorithms on Earth Observation data to identify the marine plastic litter problem spots. Then, it uses blockchain to incentivize the collectors and encourage recycling. Our solution is enabling end-to-end recycling interventions. It will save billion tonnes of CO2, save natural systems, the marine food chains contamination and the serious consequences it has on human health.

The solution falls in line with the European Green Deal and, in particular with the objectives of the European Climate Law, the EU climate adaptation and mitigation strategies, the EU biodiversity strategy for 2030, the EU proposal for a nature restoration law, the Marine Strategy Framework Directive (MSFD), the UNFCCC Ocean and Climate Change Dialogue, the Global Biodiversity Framework, and many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in particular restoring our ocean and waters related actions will directly contribute to SDG 14 - Life below water and SDG 6 - Clean water and sanitation, as well as to SDG13 - Climate action.

In 2020 we were incubated by the Parsec Accelerator (Horizon 2020 grant no 824478, supporting the creation of new Earth Observation (EO) based products and services. We have received a €10,000 financing. This has enabled to develop our solution to TRL 4 (Ideation of the technology prototype & validate it in lab as well as confirming the product/market fit after interviews with stakeholders). 

In 2021, we were accelerated by the InnovationLabs Accelerator, where we won the Spin-off of the Year Award. This program has enabled us to build the MVP and reach TRL 5. 

In 2022, we have received support in services being valued at €50,000 in total, including a Sub-Grant of €20,000 from the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT) via EIT Climate-KIC Holding B.V. (“Climate-KIC”) under KAVA 7.1.4 Black Sea ClimAccelerator. Under this program, our climate impact was assesed and we have protected our IP (registered trademark and registered design). Right now, our main challenge is to validate our prototype in a first end-to end intervention.
entityDescription: Recycllux is a Romanian startup that proposes a systemic approach for preserving and restoring marine ecosystems which have an impact on emissions and removals of emissions, conservation and enhancement of these natural carbon sinks. Building on the research from Alexandra’s PHD thesis, we have developed a ML algorithm that makes use of the Sentinel-1 and 2 big open EO data in combination with ground-truth data to accurately identify marine litter aggregations. Knowing the waste accumulations allows one to calculate how many tonnes of CO2 are not absorbed as a result of that specific litter accumulation. Between 2020-2022, with financing and Support from the Parsec Accelerator and from the EIT Climate-KIC BlackSea ClimAccelerator, we have managed to build the solution MVP.

entityDescription:
Weather ship routing in cargo shipping today has only managed to save 3-10% in GHG emissions mainly because the input weather forecasts are not precise enough. Numerical forecast models producing these inputs have reached an accuracy dead-end due to the modelling complexity of the involved physical processes. AlongRoute is using ground-breaking AI models which overcome these barriers by “learning” how physics work. With our marine weather forecasts, existing ship routing solutions can perform up to 200% better than today which could save up to 3 million t of cargo ship GHG, in only one year. Our models are projected to evolve, whereas numerical forecast models have long reached their precision capacity. In contrast to existing models, our set-up is extremely efficient in terms of computational requirements and thus can easily produce forecasts in fine spatial and temporal resolutions.
The ideation of AlongRoute venture began in December 2021, when, with the help of PRAXI network, OMIKRON Environmental Consultants SA from Greece teamed up with Alisio Computing GmbH, from Germany. Together, the two EU SMEs formed the basic framework of the venture that would follow. They submitted a proposal at the DigiCirc Blue Economy Accelerator Programme in which they succeeded to participate Phase I and II. During these phases they were intensively supported to develop the Proof of Concept, the Business Plan with Market Research, Revenue Model and Financial Projections as well as the first operational MVP for the Mediterranean Sea. At the end of Phase II the consortium pitched in from of an external group of judges and were selected to proceed to Phase III (5 winners out of 15 teams). In October 2022, the start-up company was established in Thessaloniki, Greece as an IKE.
